author: Mark Atwood
text:
Workspace-wide sweep scope check + recommendation.

Verified the same pattern is in canonical jmap-mail-server at two sites:
  - mail-server/src/memory/mod.rs:402-407 — query_objects: '(position as usize).min(total)' + 'position.saturating_neg() as usize'
  - mail-server/src/memory/mod.rs:977-980 — query_changes: '(position as usize).min(total)' + '(-position) as usize' (the bare-negation variant, which is the actually-broken-on-i64::MIN one the bead warns about).

Per canonical-template propagation rule: change canonical first, then propagate to all 8 extension-server siblings. Cost: 8 crates touched (chat, calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, metadata, sharing, mail). Benefit: replace two as-casts with one try_from + unsigned_abs() at each site.

The triggering client input (position = i64::MIN) is wire-format impossible — JMAP /query positions are small offsets. The 'works by accident' framing is accurate: the cast lossiness is hidden by the saturating_sub clamp downstream.

My recommendation: close as wontfix.
  - Strictly P3 opinion (bead's own classification).
  - Bug is theoretical — no client wire-format produces i64::MIN positions.
  - Rewrite trades two as-casts for one as-cast plus try_from + unsigned_abs — net 'easier to audit' but not net 'shorter'.
  - 8-crate canonical sweep for a P3 opinion finding is exactly the bikeshedding workspace AGENTS.md warns against.
  - If the workspace converges and someone later wants a no-as-casts hygiene sweep across the family, it can be revived as a clean canonical-template parent.

Alternatives, in order of cost:
  (1) wontfix — my vote.
  (2) Local-only fix to metadata-server, accept canonical divergence (violates propagation rule; should NOT do this).
  (3) File new parent epic 'workspace canonical-template hygiene sweep: query_objects/query_changes position handling', work mail-server first, propagate to 7 siblings. P3 opinion → P3 chore.

Filing as human-labeled because the canonical-template rule promotes this from a local-crate decision to a workspace-architectural one, and the cost/benefit on workspace-wide P3 opinion sweeps is exactly the kind of call AGENTS.md says I should not auto-decide.
